brief: Hydrophone H-2 detected a likely North Atlantic right whale up-call with a confidence score of 1.00 (synthetic demo clip), and a 10 nm slow zone was issued to the 4 vessels inside it. Nordic Tide, Harbor Queen and Blue Fin II slowed to 10 knots or less, giving 75% compliance, while Cape Runner only went from 19 to 17 knots. Recommend contacting Cape Runner directly to slow to 10 knots or less; all vessel data in this demo is simulated.
